<style>
/* UNO no canto + asset PNG transparente embutido */
#uno .unopic{
  left:18px!important;
  bottom:12px!important;
  width:245px!important;
  max-width:38%!important;
  height:auto!important;
  max-height:175px!important;
  object-fit:contain!important;
  object-position:left bottom!important;
  background:transparent!important;
  border:0!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 20px #000b)!important;
  z-index:1!important;
}
#uno .yes{left:62%!important;top:47%!important;z-index:4}
#uno .no{z-index:5}
#uno h3,#uno p{position:relative;z-index:4}
</style>
<script>
(() => {
  const UNO_DATA='data:image/png;base64,[... ELLIPSIZATION ...]';
  function installUno(){
    const img=document.querySelector('#uno .unopic');
    if(img){
      img.src=UNO_DATA;
      img.removeAttribute('srcset');
    }
  }
  installUno();
  const oldShowFinal=showFinal;
  showFinal=function(){oldShowFinal();setTimeout(installUno,0)};
  const oldUnlockUno=unlockUno;
  unlockUno=function(){oldUnlockUno();setTimeout(installUno,0)};
})();
</script>
